001: It turns out I have a business trip to Osaka next month.
That sounds tough. How many days is it for?
Three days. But after that, I'm thinking of taking paid leave and stopping by Kyoto.
That's nice. Being able to enjoy both work and sightseeing sounds ideal.
Exactly. Since I'm going all that way, I thought I might stretch my legs a bit.
Kyoto is a place that's great no matter how many times you go, so I recommend it.
002: Have you already made plans for your summer vacation?
Not yet. Is there anywhere you'd recommend?
I went to Hokkaido last year, and it was truly wonderful.
Hokkaido, huh? What stood out to you the most?
The food, hands down. Seafood and dairy products — everything I ate was delicious.
That sounds appealing. Maybe I'll decide on Hokkaido this year.
003: I need to book a Shinkansen ticket for next week's business trip.
Would you like me to book it for you?
Really? That would be a big help. If possible, I'd like a window seat.
Understood. What day and around what time would you like to depart?
I'd like to leave Tuesday morning.
Then I'll look for options around that time.
004: It's been a while since I've taken a long vacation.
Have you decided where you're going?
I'm planning to go to Okinawa for a week. I just want to relax by the sea.
That sounds nice. I went to Okinawa last year, and it was truly healing.
Really? Is there anywhere you'd recommend?
You should definitely check out the Churaumi Aquarium. It's amazing.
005: My business trip schedule suddenly changed.
That's rough. When did it change to?
It's now from Monday to Thursday next week.
In that case, what about the meeting you had planned for Friday?
I've decided to join it online.
That's a good way to handle it. Do you need any help with the preparations?
006: Are you going anywhere during Golden Week?
I don't really have any plans. Do you know any good places?
I go back to my parents' home every year. But this year, I'm a bit torn.
Since it's a rare long holiday, I'm also considering a trip abroad.
That sounds great. Which countries are you considering?
007: Have you already decided where you're staying for the business trip?
No, not yet. Do you have a hotel you'd recommend?
I think a hotel close to the station would be convenient.
You're right. I want to keep travel time short.
In that case, a business hotel near the station would be a good choice.
Thank you. I'll go ahead and make a reservation right away.
008: I have a lot of paid leave left over.
That's such a waste. Let's use it up in a planned way.
That's true. I'm thinking of going to a hot spring in the fall.
That sounds nice. Which area's hot spring is it?
I'm considering Hakone. It's close to Tokyo, too.
Hakone is great, isn't it? I went last year too, and it was really nice.
009: I got an offer for an overseas business trip next month.
That's a big opportunity. Which country is it?
Singapore. It's my first time, so I'm a little nervous.
I've been there before too, and it's a very easy city to get around in.
Really? That puts my mind at ease a bit.
If you ever run into any trouble with the preparations, feel free to ask me anytime.
010: Do you think you'll be able to rest well over the New Year's holidays?
No, actually, it looks like I'll be working even during the first three days of the year.
That's rough. When are you planning to take time off instead?
I'm thinking of taking about a week off at the end of January.
Make sure you rest up and recharge.
Thank you. I'm planning to relax at a hot spring.
